newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to visit Denmark after Yeltsin summit.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to visit Denmark after Yeltsin summit.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton will visit Denmark on March 21 following his meeting with Russian President Boris Yeltsin in Helsinki, the White House announced on Tuesday.
It will be the first visit to Denmark by a U.S. president and will provide Clinton "with an opportunity to celebrate our strong ties of friendship," White House spokesman Mike McCurry said.
Clinton is to meet Yeltsin March 20-21 in Helsinki, the Finnish capital.

McCurry, in a statement issued during a visit by Clinton to New York, said the visit to Denmark would highlight that country's role in helping to build an undivided Europe and promoting security and stability in the Baltic region.
He said Clinton looked forward to meeting Queen Margrethe II and to discussing bilateral and regional issues with Prime Minister Poul Nyrup Rasmussen and other Danish leaders.
